summary.description: STRIDE threat model of SecureNova Inc. LLM customer-service platform. Identities: human users, AI agent, OAuth M2M client, LLM API key, RAG pipeline service identity, MCP server identity. Trust boundaries: User Layer | Agent Layer | Internal API Layer.

cells.description: Customer or CSR authenticating via Auth0 Universal Login (OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE / OIDC).
Federated identity: Universal Login, Social and Enterprise connections, Attack Protection, MFA, M2M clients.
External model service account authenticated with rotated LLM API keys.
Non-human identity that acts on behalf of the user: OBO user token + constrained M2M client. Calls REST, RAG, MCP, and LLM. Trust boundaries: User Layer to Agent Layer to Internal API Layer.

threats.title: Spoofed AI agent presents stolen OBO token
threats.description: An attacker replays or forges an Auth0 on-behalf-of access token so a fake agent calls internal APIs and MCP tools as a legitimate customer-service agent.
threats.mitigation: Bind tokens to agent instance (cnf/DPoP), short TTL, mTLS, Ed25519 request signing, deny implicit trust between agents.

threats.title: RAG context or tool arguments tampered in store
threats.description: Chunks or MCP payloads are modified so the agent executes attacker-chosen tools (RAG poisoning / supply chain).
threats.mitigation: Sign and hash chunks; ingest allow-list; MCP tool schema allow-list; integrity checks before retrieval.

threats.title: Missing non-human identity audit trail
threats.description: Agent, MCP, and RAG actions are not bound to a durable actor ID, so operators cannot prove who invoked which tool.
threats.mitigation: Signed audit events with agent_id, user_sub, client_id, tool name, and RAG chunk IDs; immutable log store.

threats.title: Prompt injection discloses LLM API key and M2M secret
threats.description: Direct or indirect prompt injection (OWASP LLM01) causes the orchestrator to echo secrets from environment, tool traces, or system prompt (LLM07).
threats.mitigation: Never place secrets in prompts; secret store plus short-lived keys; output guardrails; tool-result redaction.

threats.title: Unbounded tool loops exhaust LLM and API quotas
threats.description: A malicious prompt or poisoned chunk causes recursive MCP/tool calls, exhausting tokens and customer-service capacity.
threats.mitigation: Rate limits per agent identity, max tool-call depth, circuit breakers, Auth0 suspicious IP throttling for user entry.

threats.title: Agent elevates from user-delegated scope to admin API scope
threats.description: Confused-deputy / scope creep: the agent uses M2M client credentials with overlapping admin scopes after a spoofed identity or poisoned RAG instruction (OWASP LLM09).
threats.mitigation: Separate M2M clients per privilege; Auth0 RBAC plus API authorization; step-up re-auth for privileged tools; Zero Trust re-verification.

cells.description: Resource server validating Auth0 JWTs. Audience-bound scopes for tickets and customer data.
Workload identity that embeds, retrieves, and ranks knowledge chunks for the agent.
Tool host authenticating agents via OAuth resource indicators and optional Ed25519-signed invocations.
Short-lived LLM API keys and M2M client secrets.
Indexed knowledge and ticket-derived chunks. Integrity-sensitive.
Append-only identity events for humans, agents, OAuth clients, and MCP.
Trust boundary: User Layer | Agent Layer
Trust boundary: Agent Layer | Internal API Layer
Trust boundary: Internal API Layer | External LLM provider
Authorization Code + PKCE; ID token + access token.
User access token constrained for agent; M2M client credentials token.
User natural-language task to agent. Crosses User Layer trust boundary.
Agent calls internal REST with user-delegated or M2M JWT. Crosses Agent to Internal boundary.
Query embedding plus top-k chunks returned into agent context.
Pipeline service identity reads/writes embeddings.
Signed tool call with agent identity and user correlation ID.
Prompt plus tools to LLM. Must not include long-lived secrets.
Runtime secret retrieval and rotation.
Tool invocation audit with agent and user IDs.
